assistant.question: How much VAT do I owe for 2026?

video.label: Demo of the nullish assistant
video.description: In the nullish app, the assistant is asked three questions about the company's books: how much a client paid this year, what is left on the bank account, and how much VAT is owed for 2026. It answers each one with figures taken from the accounting: the client's paid invoices, the bank balance with money in and out since the start of the year, and the VAT due under the net rate method.

boring.label: the boring part
boring.title: And of course, all the basics.

lessBoring.label: the fun part
lessBoring.title: Accounting isn’t exactly exciting.
lessBoring.punchline: So we added a few twists.

cards.title: No dashboard. Just ask.
cards.text: “Which invoices are still open?” or “Mark invoice 42 as paid.” In the app or from your own AI agent.

cards.title: QR-bills that don’t gossip.
cards.text: Payment references are random, so your clients can’t read how business is going.

cards.title: Hide the numbers.
cards.text: Blur the amounts when someone’s reading over your shoulder.

cards.title: Invoices that look like you.
cards.text: Customize the whole template, not just a logo and a line of text.

cards.title: Crypto? Sure.
cards.text: Every currency gets the decimals it needs, even all 18 of them for Ether.

cards.title: Open source.
cards.text: Audit every line, run it on your own servers, change what you need.

swiss.title: Developed in Züri
swiss.text: nullish is designed and built in Zürich.

swiss.title: Hosted in Switzerland
swiss.text: Your data stays on Swiss infrastructure.

swiss.title: The AI lives in Switzerland too
swiss.text: Your questions never leave the country.

items.title: Clients and contacts
items.text: Keep track of who you bill and the people you deal with.

items.title: Invoices
items.text: In CHF or any other currency, from draft to paid.

items.title: Swiss QR-bill
items.text: Printed on your invoices, with a random reference that reveals nothing.

items.title: Statement import
items.text: Download and import your bank statements, from any Swiss bank.

items.title: Reconciliation
items.text: QR-bill payments are matched automatically with their invoice.

items.title: Double-entry bookkeeping
items.text: Every entry in debit and credit. The full bookkeeping a GmbH or AG has to keep.

items.title: Journal
items.text: Book entries by hand, or duplicate recurring ones like the rent.

items.title: Traceable entries
items.text: Numbered, linked to their invoice or bank movement, and locked once the year is closed.

items.title: Year-end closing
items.text: Close the year, and the balances carry over to the next one.

items.title: Reports
items.text: Balance sheet, income statement and account ledger.

items.title: Currencies
items.text: Use any fiat or crypto currency without losing precision.

items.title: Methods
items.text: Agreed or received, effective or net tax rate.

items.title: VAT declaration
items.text: Prepared per VAT period, from your invoices and entries.

items.title: Ask
items.text: Prompt the assistant about your invoices, bank accounts or VAT, and get answers from your own figures.

items.title: Read or write
items.text: By default it only answers. Switch to write when you feel confident letting it make changes.

items.title: Hosted in Switzerland
items.text: The model runs at Infomaniak. Your questions and figures stay in the country and are never used for training.

items.title: Templates
items.text: Change the whole layout of your documents, like invoices, and customize them with your branding.

items.title: Hide amounts
items.text: Blur the amounts when someone's reading over your shoulder.

items.title: REST API
items.text: Integrate nullish into your own tools and workflows.

items.title: MCP server
items.text: Connect Claude, ChatGPT or your own agent, with the same tools as the assistant.

items.title: MIT license
items.text: Free to use, change and share, commercially too.

items.title: Transparency
items.text: Every line is on GitHub. Check for yourself how your figures are calculated.

items.title: Self-hosting
items.text: Run nullish on your own servers, on your own or with our help.
